tools.name: search_wods
tools.description: Search CrossFit workouts (WODs) by query, type, difficulty, tag, modality, equipment, muscle group, duration, or ordering.

tools.name: get_wod_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific CrossFit workout (WOD) by ID or slug.

tools.name: get_my_workout_results
tools.description: Get logged workout history and results for the authenticated user. User authentication is handled automatically via OAuth.

tools.name: add_workout_result
tools.description: Record a completed workout result into user's Wodcat log. User authentication is handled automatically via OAuth.

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.description: Search CrossFit exercises by name, equipment, modality, level, or movement.

tools.name: get_exercise_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific CrossFit exercise by slug.

tools.name: search_training_plans
tools.description: Search CrossFit training plans / workout routines by name, goal, athlete level, or ordering.

tools.name: get_training_plan_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific training plan by slug.

tools.name: search_gyms
tools.description: Search CrossFit gyms / boxes by name, country, city, type, or open status.

tools.name: get_gym_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific CrossFit gym by slug.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search CrossFit competitions and events by status ('new'/'old'), country, city, gym, or type.

tools.name: get_event_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific CrossFit event by slug.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search fitness and CrossFit articles by author or ordering.

tools.name: get_article_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific article by slug.

tools.name: get_leaderboards
tools.description: Get Wodcat athlete leaderboards ('skill' or 'activity') with optional country, city, or gym filters.
